contract.hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, SM120a
contract.output: one FP32 maximum power and one uniform-angle beam index per batch
contract.timing: direct launch, CUDA events, 20 warmups, 100 iterations, six direction-balanced processes

decision.implementation: accepted strongest measured bounded-workspace Fourier control
decision.boundary: not a proof against all specialized NUFFT or CZT implementations
decision.allowed_wording: A quality-passing L4096 FP32 cuFFT control streams two batches through uniform-angle interpolation and the same power/top-1 consumer using 64 MiB; it takes 7.769 ms, 16.498x the Beam24 latency.
